figurative_meaning_en: not finding a place to stay
example_sentences_in_bangla: বৃষ্টির রাতে শহরে এসে সে অন্ধকারে থেকেছে।
যাত্রীদের ভিড়ে হোটেল না পেয়ে তারা অন্ধকারে থাকল।
example_sentences_in_english: Coming to the city on a rainy night, he was left in the dark without a place to stay.
Unable to find a hotel amid the crowd of travelers, they were left in the dark.
note: The original meaning appears to have typographical errors; interpreted as relating to lack of shelter.
